text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Everton and Luton Town at Goodison Park!

It's been a good week for Everton - they picked up their first Premier League win of the season last time out, beating Brentford 3-1 on Saturday before following it up with an EFL Cup third-round win over Aston Villa in midweek to progress to the next round.
They're looking to keep building on this momentum and turn around their fortunes at home after failing to win and score in all three of their games at Goodison Park so far.

events.action: turn around their fortunes at home

text: Luton, on the other hand, are still looking for their first win in the league this season, but did get their first point on the board in a 1-1 draw with 10-man Wolves last weekend.
They've lost their other four games in the competition, and come into this game after being knocked out of the EFL Cup by League One side, Exeter City, in their midweek match.
Sean Dyche makes four changes from the side that knocked Villa out of the EFL Cup on Wednesday.
Young, Gueye, McNeil and Doucoure are all brought in, while Mykolenko has passed a late fitness test to retain his place.
Keane, Patterson, Harrison and Danjuma drop to the bench.
After ringing in the changes for their midweek loss to Exeter, Rob Edwards goes back to the side that drew with Wolves in their last Premier League game, with one enforced alteration.
Albert Sambi Lokonga picked up a hamstring injury in that match, so he's out.
Mpanzu comes in to replace him.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Ogbene gets the game under way for Luton!
It's Everton trying to pile on some early pressure and it's knocked back to Tarkowski who sends it long over the top.
Doucoure has made a good run through the middle, but Lockyer gets across to cut it out.
CLOSE! Doucoure's pass out to McNeil on the left is short, but a lazy touch by Kabore helps it into the winger's feet anyway.
It bounces up in front of him and he strikes it on the volley, but it flashes wide of the far post.
SAVE! It's lovely work from Everton down the left, but Mykolenko's cross is put out from a throw-in.
The left-back gets it straight back from Doucoure and this time picks out a good ball, but Calvert-Lewin's header is straight at Kaminski.
It's a good, darting run from Ogbene down the left, and he pulls it back to Nakamba when he spots him in space on the edge of the box.
He leans back as he takes the shot though, and it's always rising over the bar.
Luton are winless in their six league games against Everton (D3 L3), with this the first such meeting between the sides since a 1-1 draw at Goodison Park in March 1992.
WIDE! Luton are wide open at the back and Doucoure switches play wonderfully out to Garner in acres of space down the right.
He cuts onto his left foot and then tries to place it, but instead curls it wide of the far post.
CHANCE! It's more good play from Everton as Onana threads it through to Doucoure.
He can't get a sight of goal so knocks it back for Gueye on the edge of the box, but he fires his first-time shot wide of the near post.
Onana finds another pocket of space in midfield and he floats a lovely pass out to Garner on the right.
He plays a dangerous low ball across the six-yard box, but nobody's there for Everton.
WIDE! Everton miss another good chance! They knock it neatly down the left, and Mykolenko flicks it to Onana.
He tries to whip a shot towards the far bottom corner, but just can't get it on target.
Down the other end, Morris holds the ball up before teeing up Ogbene for another driving run down the left.
He pulls it back to the penalty spot towards Brown, but Onana gets back in time to hook it away.
Luton are starting to grow into this game, and Bell plays a good reverse pass into Doughty on the left.
He holds the ball up instead of putting it into the box, but does manage to win a corner.
OVER! The resulting corner is swung in by Doughty, and his out-swinging cross picks out Lockyer in the middle.
He rises high to thump a header towards goal, but it flies over the bar.
Onana is screaming for the ball in midfield and Garner eventually picks him out.
He tries to slide it into the box for Calvert-Lewin, but they're not on the same wavelength, so it's a comfortable take for Kaminski.
LOCKYER SCORES! Everton just haven't been able to cope with Luton on corners, and the visitors have punished them! Doughty swings another dangerous cross in and Morris thumps a header on goal.
It hits the bottom of the crossbar and bounces in front of Young, who tries to clear it.
He hits the ball straight against Lockyer, who throws himself in front of it, and it hits the back of the net.
1-0 Luton!
Everton are looking to regain some of their earlier dominance and it's hooked upfield to Calvert-Lewin again.
This time, he fouls his man trying to nod it down, and Luton have a free-kick.
Mpanzu went down after being shrugged off the ball in midfield, and he's holding his side.
He slowly gets back up to his feet, and he can carry on without treatment.
CHANCE! Everton's threat comes from their left again, and McNeil jinks past Morris before whipping a dangerous cross into Calvert-Lewin.
He can't get enough contact on the ball though, and ends up glancing it wide.
Onana has nicked the ball off Morris, but Tarkowski bundles into the forward, giving away a needless free-kick, which Doughty is standing over.
MORRIS SCORES! The forward peels away from the line of Everton defenders on the edge of the box, and he's completely free at the far post.
Doughty picks him out, and Morris meets the ball on the half-volley, sending it across goal and out of Pickford's reach.
2-0 Luton!
It's another delightful delivery from Doughty, who is causing Everton all sorts of problems with the set-pieces that he's taking.
The rain is coming down even heavier now, and the slick surface is causing a few problems.
Morris nods it forward for Ogbene, and Young's pass almost plays in the winger, but he manages to get it back to Pickford.
Gueye finds himself in a pocket of space just outside the box and shapes to shoot before deciding against it.
Instead, he touches it out to Mykolenko, but nobody is in the middle for the hosts to meet his cross.
OFF THE BAR! Everton work it well down their left once more, and McNeil floats a great cross towards the far post.
Garner darts forward to meet it and thumps a header on goal.
Kaminski is beaten, but it smacks off the crossbar.
Everton are still seeing a lot of the ball, but they're finding it difficult to break down Luton.
Tarkowski lifts another long ball over the top that forces Calvert-Lewin wide, which means that nobody is in the box for the hosts again.
CALVERT-LEWIN PULLS ONE BACK! Pickford's long ball is only half-cleared by Luton and Garner swings a follow-up cross into the middle.
Onana is onside as he pokes it on goal, but Kaminski denies him.
The keeper then scrambles across to deny Doucoure from close range but he can't get to Calvert-Lewin's prod.
VAR is having a long look, but it'll count!
VAR is checking two things on this goal.
The first is whether or not there was a foul on Burke in the build-up, and that's cleared up pretty quickly.
The second is whether or not Calvert-Lewin is offside.
It's a tight call, and it's taking some time to figure out.
THE GOAL STANDS! Everton have their first home goal of the season! Burke was leaning slightly to the left, and it's his shoulder that was playing Calvert-Lewin onside.
BLOCK! We're into six minutes of added time after that VAR check, and Everton win a free-kick on the left.
Kaminski doesn't get any distance on his punched clearance and Garner hits it on the volley as it drops.
Burke blocks it in front of the line.
There are big shouts for a handball from the home fans and players as it strikes Bell.
He was stood very close to Garner with his arm low by his side, and the referee gives a shake of his head.
Everton are searching for a goal that would take them into the break level.
They're switching it from side to side, and Mykolenko finally finds some space, but Kaminski plucks his cross straight out of the air.
HALF-TIME: EVERTON 1-2 LUTON TOWN.
Luton take a 2-1 lead over Everton into half-time.
It was the hosts with all of the early chances, but they struggled to test Kaminski.

Luton took the lead through Lockyer - Doughty's corner was thumped against the underside of the bar by Morris, and the Hatters captain threw himself in front of Young's clearance to send it into the goal.
Morris then doubled their lead from another set-piece, peeling away to send an unmarked volley past Pickford.
At the other end, Garner smacked the bar with a header before Calvert-Lewin prodded home Everton's first home goal of the season to pull one back.
Edwards will be fairly pleased with what he's seen from his side - they soaked up a lot of pressure before exploiting Everton's weaknesses on set-pieces to get their two goals.
He'll want to restore that two-goal cushion though.
Half-time came at the wrong time for the hosts as they were starting to assert some dominance again.
Calvert-Lewin netted an important goal, and Dyche will want to build on that after the break.
There's a change apiece at the break, starting with Everton.
Gueye is taken off, with Harrison on in his place.
And for Luton, it's Burke that's making way, with Andersen replacing him.
Everton get us back under way for the second half!
Luton are looking to make a strong start to the second half, and they're keeping Everton penned back in their own half.
Ogbene tries to cut inside from the left, but Young stands his ground to stop him from getting into the box.
Everton haven't really got going so far in the second half.
They're struggling to string passes together, and Luton look comfortable at the moment.
The space opens up for Brown in the box and as he shapes to shoot, Tarkowski slides in with a perfectly-timed tackle to take it off him.
Doughty takes the resulting corner, but this one sails over everyone.
Everton work it quickly upfield, but they're struggling to get the ball into the box.
They're still looking to their left side to make something happen, but it's not coming off.
Lockyer went down in need of treatment, and Luton aren't going to risk him.
He makes his way off the pitch with the medical team, and Mengi comes on to make his Premier League debut.
Ogbene goes down, asking for a free-kick that doesn't come.
From that, Pickford plays out from the back, looking to get his side upfield.
Onana tries to slide it down the right for Harrison, but Doughty shields it out of play.
Everton are making their second change as they continue their search for an equaliser.
Doucoure is taken off, with Beto on in his place.
CHANCE! It's better from Everton here as Tarkowski loops another long ball over the top.
Calvert-Lewin watches it drop over his shoulder and hits it on the volley, but his effort dribbles just wide of the far post.
OFFSIDE! Luton go straight down the other end and put the ball in the net, but it won't count! Doughty clips a good cross into the far post and Brown nods it over Pickford.
Morris is on the line to help it over the line, but a belated flag goes up against Brown.
Branthwaite and Morris collide during an aerial challenge and the referee waves on the medical teams due to both players holding their heads.
Morris and Branthwaite are both back on their feet now and they'll be able to carry on after finishing their treatment.
Luton win a throw-in, and Kabore looks like he's going to take it before handing it over to Andersen instead.
The referee doesn't like that, and Kabore is booked for time-wasting.
Doughty's latest corner hits Garner as it's swung in, and VAR is just having a quick look at it.
It did strike the midfielder on the arm, but he was moving it down to his side, and there won't be a penalty awarded to Luton.
Harrison gets a yard on Bell as he drives down the right and he clips a deep cross into the six-yard box.
Kaminski chooses to leave it, and Beto reaches it on the far side, but can only put it into the side netting.
Harrison switches play out to Mykolenko on the left, and he lays it off into Beto's path.
He has space for a shot, but chooses to leave it for McNeil instead, which allows Luton to get back and block it.
There are more big shouts for a penalty, this time from the home fans.
McNeil plays a good reverse pass into Calvert-Lewin, who goes shoulder-to-shoulder with Mengi, and when the forward goes down, the referee waves the claim away.
GREAT CHANCE! McNeil has people to aim for in the box this time, and he curls it into the far post, where Garner nods it down.
Beto has a free header and flicks it towards the near top corner from close range, but it sails over the bar.
Garner cuts open Luton's backline with a great pass into the box, and Beto races onto it.
He stumbles over the ball and manages to scuff a shot just wide from a tight angle.
Luton are making their second change here.
Morris, whose goal is the difference at the moment, is replaced by Adebayo.
And Everton's latest change sees Patterson coming on for Young.
Luton are sitting deep and trying to make life difficult for Everton in the final third.
Harrison plays a hopeful ball into the box from the right, but it's an easy one for Kabore to deal with at the far post.
Luton have a problem here as Kaminski is down in his box with a groin problem.
The physio is on to give him some treatment, but he's okay to carry on.
Luton are making another change as they get ready to defend this Everton corner.
Doughty goes off, with Woodrow on in his place.
Final roll of the dice for Everton now as Danjuma is brought on for McNeil.
OVER! Everton are upping the pressure here and after the first cross is cleared, the hosts recycle it.
Garner lifts it into the far post and Beto thumps a header across goal which sails over the bar.
Luton are still standing their ground at the back, and Everton are desperately trying to get it forward.
At the moment, they're struggling to string together enough passes to do that.
Mpanzu makes another good interception and drives down the right.
His only aim is to keep Everton out of Luton's half by dragging the hosts back towards their own goal.
WIDE! Tarkowski has played some wonderful long balls over the top today, and this one is no different as he drops it into Calvert-Lewin.
He lets it bounce before firing on goal, but he hits the side netting.
Everton are very much going for the direct route as Tarkowski sends it long once more.
This time, he picks out Onana on the right of the box and he nods it towards Beto, but Bell is there for Luton.
Luton have everyone back in their own half as they continue to protect what would be a precious first-ever Premier League win.
Brown does well as he drags Mykolenko out to him and wins a goal-kick off the left-back.
FULL-TIME: EVERTON 1-2 LUTON TOWN.
Luton win their first-ever Premier League game, beating Everton 2-1.
All of the work was done in the first half from two set-pieces.
The first was a corner, which Morris thumped against the crossbar, and Lockyer threw himself in front of Young's clearance to deflect it into the net.
Then a free-kick, where Doughty picked out the unmarked Morris, and he volleyed past Pickford.
Everton responded well, with Garner rattling the bar with a header before Calvert-Lewin poked a goal back from close range.
The Toffees desperately pushed in the second half, but couldn't manage to test Kaminski.
It's a win that lifts Luton out of the relegation zone and up to 17th, only behind Everton now on goal difference.
They'll play their game in hand against Burnley in midweek.
That's four home defeats on the bounce for the Toffees, who go off to boos.
They'll be hoping to change that against Bournemouth next weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
